recording.scope: The source identifies the syllable ma spoken in four tones. It does not establish the speaker's native language or provide phonetic or F0 ground truth.

source.selectionRule: Manually chosen quiet gaps around each isolated syllable; not phonetic onset/offset labels. Crop start floors and end ceils at the decoded sample rate.
